title: Boskin Commission's 1.1% CPI overstatement

tellings.quote: So there was a crime going on which the Bosan Commission was committing against the American people by putting in a 1.1% overstatement in the CPI by hand

plain: In the 1990s, a government panel called the Boskin Commission, which looked at how US inflation is measured, is said to have built a 1.1% overstatement by hand into the consumer price index, the official measure of rising prices. A researcher named Eric Weinstein tells Michels this, without naming a source, and calls it a crime the commission committed against the American people, an example in his telling of officials quietly working against the public.
